selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a similar shelving unit or cabinet.
To verify the 3D consistency of the shelves and back panel, ensuring no 'melting' or impossible geometry in the depth perception.
To check for boundary bleeding between the books and the shelves, a common AI artifact where objects fuse into their support structures.
To assess general image quality, lighting consistency, and texture realism.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the spines of the books. AI generators often produce gibberish text or warped spines. Also, verify that the vertical sides of the bookcase are perfectly straight and parallel, as perspective distortion or bending is a common geometric failure in generated furniture.
